decisions.reason: As a low-cost finish variant within the core drainage range, it is worth keeping because another year on the market likely reduced uncertainty while the option value remains higher than the small carrying cost.
This shower channel fits the firm’s established technical and architectural offer for modern seamless bathrooms, so management would likely continue it as a now more credible core-range option.

Although pump-assisted drainage is more support-intensive and uncertain, it extends the firm into difficult installation cases with meaningful upside, so it is still worth keeping as an option for now.
As a newer pump-drain launch close to the firm’s drainage capabilities, it would typically be kept to learn about demand and technical acceptance before any pruning decision is made.
